text: ロケットだん　じゃない　ごめんなさい　あたし　てっきり…　でんじはの　わざを　おしえたげる　から　ゆるしてね

structure.jp: ロケットだん　じゃない
でんじはの　わざを　おしえたげる　から
structure.en: I'll teach you the move Thunder Wave, so

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: てあげる after a verb says you do it as a favour for someone; たげる is the squashed-together casual form. おしえたげる = 'I'll teach it to you'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.span: おしえたげる　から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what comes next. おしえたげる　から = 'I'll teach you, so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a casual way of asking someone to do it. ゆるしてね = 'forgive me, okay?'
